scope_limit: Selected phase1 test groups and matched recorded benchmarks; no claim that all method or repository test suites passed.

method.cold: repeat 0, new process, first independent geometry-to-result calculation; core package imports precede task timer, remaining lazy imports/JIT and first GW screening NPZ write stay inside recorded task time
method.warm: median of repeats 1,2,3 in the same process, each with fresh molecular and method objects; no final-result reuse
method.other_times: Wrapper wall_seconds and process_wall_seconds are retained separately and never mixed into task ratios.
method.group_rss: 50 ms sampled process-group resident RSS; includes startup, compilation and every completed/started repeat; short peaks may be missed
method.worker_rss: Linux ru_maxrss process high-water mark, includes earlier repeats; not isolated warm memory
method.performance_ratios: after/before and GradSCF/PySCF only for identical physical task, device/thread count and complete cold+3-warm runs. RI and spectral 4c compression are separate tasks.
method.source_lineage_limit: Source/branch/manifests and fixed outer PYTHONPATH/environment provide run-level provenance; per-case process records do not hash or independently attest the imported GradSCF source. before/after directory labels are stage-specific, not one uniform baseline commit attribution.
method.native_execution: libcint CPU kernels; GPU NNAO model/SCF uses explicit CPU integral/projection/pullback transfers
